feed.title: NPR Topics: National
feed.subtitle: Follow NPR National News for reporting across the United States. Explore coverage of economic affordability, immigration, climate, environmental policy, justice and social trends.

entry.title: Trump's impact on an Ohio steel plant
entry.summary: The giant steel plant in Middletown, Ohio planned to switch away from using coke, a refined form of coal. The switch would have cut hazardous air pollution -- and greenhouse gas emissions. But that plan has changed under President Trump

entry.title: MLK's handwritten draft of iconic speech on display for the first time
entry.summary: The only known handwritten draft of The Reverend Martin Luther King Jr.'s 'I Have a Dream' speech is on display in his hometown. The iconic phrase, however, never made it on the page.

entry.title: Preppers aren't afraid of an outage
entry.summary: In the wake of a series of tech failures, major government network crashes and flight stoppages, many people online are looking to preppers to learn how to become self-reliant.

entry.title: A second judge blocks Trump's arch, saying it's unlikely to succeed in court
entry.summary: A federal judge in Virginia said she will issue a preliminary injunction against Trump's arch, going a step further than the D.C. federal judge who temporarily blocked construction earlier this week.

entry.title: Texas execution took over an hour as staff struggled to find vein; Reinaldo Dennes moaned about pain
entry.summary: The same day Dennes was given lethal injection, Florida carried out a record-breaking 20th execution of the year.

entry.title: GOP Sen. Johnson rejects tying government funding to an end to the Iran war
entry.summary: "We're not going to shut down the war," Sen. Ron Johnson said as Republicans and Democrats struggle to reach a government funding deal.

entry.title: Senate passes bipartisan energy bill amid environmental concerns
entry.summary: As Americans struggle with rising energy costs and increased demand driven by AI, the Senate passed a bipartisan bill that will speed up the approval process for data centers and power plants.

entry.title: Critics are calling what brand-new release a masterpiece? The quiz knows
entry.summary: Plus: Are you up to date on your James Bond news? If so, you'll get at least one question right.

entry.title: New York City unveils a bold plan to move its jails off Rikers Island
entry.summary: New York City officials are moving forward with plans to close Rikers, the city's main jail complex, after years of discussion. The jail has been plagued by assaults and inmate deaths.

entry.title: Morning news brief
entry.summary: Without funding deal, the government could shut down next month, Silicon Valley and national security community bump heads on efforts to restrict U.S. tech to China, Army delays detonation in Iowa.
